turns.question: What was the ratio of non-cancelled order revenue to total ad spend in September 2026?
turns.answer: The semantic layer has no ratio metric for revenue to ad spend, so I cannot give that ratio; the closest metrics give Revenue (EUR) of 12,582.75 EUR from non-cancelled orders and Ad spend (EUR) of 6,270.00 EUR, both for 2026-09-01 to 2026-09-30.
